channel.title: Paste Media Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: Glen Powell does more of the same in crime-comedy How To Make A Killing
item.description: An heir murders his way to the top in How To Make A Killing, a film with simple observations and a predictable lead turn.

item.title: Lucinda Williams’ greatest weapon is the song she’s singing
item.description: Q&A: The alt-country legend sat down with Paste to discuss bringing courage to her vocation, what it takes to write political music that lives up to her hero Bob Dylan’s, and her most recent album, World’s Gone Wrong.

item.title: Twisted Teens have a deep-fried punk wigout on Blame the Clown
item.description: Paste Pick: The New Orleans duo’s second album is full of tonal psychosis, whip-smart melodies, chatty pedal steel, and nifty, out-of-pocket lyrical assertions. It’s rare to find a band this good this early.

item.title: R.I.P. Tom Noonan, RoboCop 2, Manhunter, Heat character actor
item.description: The actor, who appeared on stage and screen for 40 years, was 74.

item.title: The Evan Dando allegations keep getting worse
item.description: According to the Lemonhead frontman’s wife, the band recorded an NPR Tiny Desk Concert that will never air because Dando was “so out of his mind.”

item.title: Steven Soderbergh calls Disney axing his Ben Solo movie "frustrating" and "insane"
item.description: "You know, that was two and a half years of free work for me," Soderbergh said, of his and Adam Driver's failed efforts to make The Hunt For Ben Solo.
